svg.title: Hub conferencing (animated)
svg.desc: Click to play each step: separate sessions, host starts conference, hub links colleagues, shared study open, synchronized navigation.
svg.text: Share the same case across workstations

g.text: Step 1: Each clinician works in their own viewer session
Step 2: The host starts a conference and invites colleagues
Step 3: The hub links their sessions for the duration of the meeting
Step 4: When the host opens a study, everyone follows the same case
Step 5: Navigation, images, and annotations stay in sync for the group
Tumor board, case review, or live teaching
- everyone sees what the group is discussing
